solution:
names = ["复述题意", "拆解难点", "安排顺序", "检查遗漏"]
values = [2, 4, 3, 1]
threshold = 2

picked = []
for i in range(len(names)):
    if values[i] >= threshold:
        picked.append(names[i])

print(picked)
